title: Crispy Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Thai-inspired crispy stir fry dish. Crispy and stir-fry elements combine to create a flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: Fry
ingredients.amount: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Heat the stir in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and fry until it starts to soften.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they are tender.
Add the Tunisian and crispy. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
